command: cd /workspace; ls; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(token\|Bearer\)[^"]*/\1 ***/I'; which mcpjam; npx --no-install @mcpjam/cli --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -40; curl -s -m 10 -i -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"t","version":"1"}}}' | head -20
cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md | head -80; which mcpjam; npm ls -g 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace; timeout 100 npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out /workspace/doctor.json 2>&1 | tail -40

cd /workspace; M="timeout 60 npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; U="--url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"
$M tools call $U --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | tail -5 | tee call_ok.json
$M tools call $U --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x"}' 2>&1 | tail -5 | tee call_bad.json

cd /workspace; cat > validate.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: MCP_SERVER_TOKEN=[REDACTED] ./validate.sh
U="--url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor $U --rpc --out doctor.json
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools call $U --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}'
npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest tools call $U --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x"}'
E
chmod +x validate.sh
